title: Northwind Health: sync failed again after re-authorization
transcript:
Agent: Northwind support, this is Elena. How can I help?
Customer: Hi Elena, Marcus again from Northwind Health. The sync worked for about a day and then stopped again. Same authentication error.
Agent: I am sorry. Let me look at ticket T-2001 and the connector logs. I see the token reset on July 10, and the re-authorization succeeded. The connector ran until 7:15 this morning and then failed.
Customer: Did the password change again?
Agent: No, I do not see another password change. The logs show the token was refreshed, but the connector did not pick up the new token. This is a known behavior when the integration is re-authorized before the token cache expires.
Customer: So what do we do?
Agent: We need to force a full re-authorization rather than a token refresh. In the admin console, go to Settings, then Integrations, then EHR Connector, and choose Disconnect. Wait for the status to change to disconnected, then click Connect and authorize again.
Customer: Okay, give me a second. All right, it is disconnected. Now I am connecting it again. It says authorization successful.
Agent: I can see the new token and the connector is processing the backlog. I will update the ticket and schedule a follow-up for July 15. If it fails again before then, call us and ask for the integration team.
Customer: Should we expect this every time the password changes?
Agent: It should not happen after a full re-authorization. The refresh path was the problem. I will add a note so the next agent knows to disconnect and reconnect, not just refresh.
Customer: Good. Thanks for explaining it.
Agent: You are welcome. I will email the updated ticket.
